# **Our Black Friday Virtual Silent Auction Is Now LIVE!**
---
|
---
| The holiday season is here, and what better way to give meaningful gifts while supporting an incredible cause? **Autism Health's Black Friday Virtual Silent Auction is officially OPEN** , offering a wonderful opportunity to shop for unique holiday gifts while making a difference in the lives of individuals and families impacted by autism. From one-of-a-kind collectibles and wellness packages to special experiences and thoughtful gifts, there's something for everyone! Whether you're shopping for loved ones or treating yourself, every winning bid helps support Autism Health's mission of advancing research, providing educational resources, expanding family support programs, and making meaningful care more accessible to those who need it most. **Our auction is completely virtual** , so you can browse and place bids from the comfort of your home, no matter where you live. It's a wonderful way to get a head start on your holiday shopping while giving back to a cause that truly matters. **The auction is LIVE NOW and closes Sunday, November 29, 2026, at 6:00 PM PST!** Don't wait until the last minute! Explore our auction items, place your bids, and share this opportunity with friends and family. **Click the link below to browse our auction and start bidding today!** Thank you for supporting Autism Health Inc. and helping us continue creating better solutions for a brighter tomorrow. Your generosity makes our mission possible!

# Thank You
Dear Neighbor, While we did not win this election, I want you to know how deeply grateful I am to everyone who stood with us. To every volunteer, donor, voter, and neighbor who put up a sign, shared our message, encouraged a friend, or took the time to speak with me—thank you. You gave your time, your resources, and your trust, and I do not take any of it for granted. We built a grassroots campaign around a simple belief: our community deserves representatives who listen, think independently, and put people first. I am proud that we stayed true to that belief. Throughout this campaign, you shared your concerns about rising utility bills, affordable healthcare, and the challenges of getting ahead. Those conversations will stay with me. The needs of our neighbors remain just as important today as they were before Election Day. I congratulate Congressman Morelle on his victory and hope he will serve everyone in our district with care and attention to the challenges families face. My commitment to this community continues. As a Monroe County Legislator and your neighbor, I will keep listening, showing up, and working to make our community a better place to live. **It was an honor to earn your support and to have the opportunity to ask for your vote.** Thank you for believing in me. With heartfelt gratitude,
**Virginia McIntyre**

body:
Since our founding, Swing Left has believed in two things working together: giving candidates the resources to compete, and organizing on the ground to win.
#
Hi there,
Last week, the American people decisively flipped the House and the Senate, and made major gains in the states, in a stinging rebuke to the Trump administration and the Republican Party. These are enormous wins, and they deserve celebration. But we’ve also seen what happens after a big election. Campaigns wind down. The energy fades. And when the next election arrives, Democrats start trying to rebuild what we could have been strengthening all along.
**We want to start the 2028 cycle differently.** We don’t know exactly what the map will look like, or who will be on the ballot, or what the country will look like when we get there. But we do know that the work of winning a presidential election can’t wait until we have an official nominee. _It needs to start right now._
**That’s why we’ve launched the 2028 Democratic Presidential Nominee Fund:**
[****](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=2028-presidential-fund.OSiNSH&utm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=campaign&%3Butm_content=20261109&%3Brefcode=refcode&t=1&akid=3418%2E1562180%2Ecb9dMU)

Here’s how it works: Your donation will be securely held until the 2028 Democratic presidential primaries are over. Then, every dollar will be released immediately to whoever wins the nomination, giving our Democratic nominee for president a powerful infusion of grassroots support the moment the general election begins.
Since our founding, Swing Left has believed in two things working together: giving candidates the resources to compete, and organizing on the ground to win. This year, you helped build both in swing races across the country.
We’re ready to keep going, and we’re counting on the entire Swing Left community to do it. Let’s keep the momentum going and get ready to win again in 2028!
— The Swing Left Team

You’ve heard about Erik on the news. He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer.
| | | | Dear Peter,I know you and I have never met. But I’m writing to you today because I’m desperate.[**I need your help to stop New York Attorney General Letitia James before she tears my family apart and locks my police officer husband up for the next NINE YEARS for doing his job.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8aa8a4d609a547cfa982ff0740de225c&_e=F6bY1wAVgP1_VBcKyJ97xg-Pad1OnwSQrw9haCj-nn1Z4o-XEoCrjCByuBaqfJsWk81jfGaKo9ggKeqfh5ZfC_UplTKzAdguxVhNVwGKznbTcgTclbrBUgY93CntlwwR9LE-rD8vcihlrOfNI7PfBKzjplXCPv880Ba7brV3cXoFhTuY4eer6DZ6rToiKRkBZgo8Yf9RpOQQBIB__ph-EjAsIERBo69mSvP9eaqbZ-QBZ7VUZWObst_oFgRjw3IhniVDkM22PJ5eNHpyV-1tYrbNGirJbIoxUWYfKdoWYcRKcRtMqwAw8KNt_ZCoDyU8IO7rNeGQ_Exzh7NZsAPpBgn7PHdM5R5F-QarOs3ydj4mNO2AhSN72HrHtG76LLHoxd8uwc6ZX71NjWvAMQv7VrL2jmsYEhn7xpKp69rTj6N8nKxtKQrS3d6xyV3XDWyllMsgWjUVM-K4jVBp-gAv6_8Vsp4JiVEvxo8o8Nwq6koXoo0xP1j_Ifk76kAiZnU7_mFfxEbzoBQo9Bm7prYtDQAeIV6r06R7mYnO4eq7iTtNQSP8wHb5vga94wyCdN8fFrt5C08VxUbGyrkm-0ZuYowVbe4ja74OmHabk82eLdu-F1B_BL4-M59jKc2tGaczu8-8S9qxkqbRDJuT8agT9jSWRM-eG2m4v4NLw3KTGSEhmcqSsoen-suQ18oMcOjyIG18mQpCNRppgHKcOsRroF3L918kMmh7uVxQVLgkN6Qiv5KA9WsNx5WJeLYijREPdqmPB-GOCoGyKmv7F1k8ATrKnxYpfPinfVq_1l7cvnnZoihNBLQDPXdTmhqC0j6lCWiu3A9pc3HzawqKkyf7fhWh8o9rU1DRa43CzDJ6BAd3T-OAaO_Veol1dGIVx5WIg9rg4IL5AfW8_TDN8KPHFvrPQgirDaArCOi85eSHe7-HinnmUBUwuAmiCWG30fr_YSR8HBIbP4DsNhcQygGppc_pFByEFbJvzci8H3q24dMGOn1al8kz1-QVTf73ZMkP)

But with the death threats we’ve been getting, I couldn’t afford to take any chances.I should explain...You’ve heard about Erik on the news.He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer who was speeding a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk.

| | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8aa8a4d609a547cfa982ff0740de225c&_e=F6bY1wAVgP1_VBcKyJ97xg-Pad1OnwSQrw9haCj-nn1Z4o-XEoCrjCByuBaqfJsWk81jfGaKo9ggKeqfh5ZfC_UplTKzAdguxVhNVwGKznbTcgTclbrBUgY93CntlwwR9LE-rD8vcihlrOfNI7PfBKzjplXCPv880Ba7brV3cXoFhTuY4eer6DZ6rToiKRkBZgo8Yf9RpOQQBIB__ph-EjAsIERBo69mSvP9eaqbZ-QBZ7VUZWObst_oFgRjw3IhniVDkM22PJ5eNHpyV-1tYrbNGirJbIoxUWYfKdoWYcRKcRtMqwAw8KNt_ZCoDyU8IO7rNeGQ_Exzh7NZsAPpBgn7PHdM5R5F-QarOs3ydj4mNO2AhSN72HrHtG76LLHoxd8uwc6ZX71NjWvAMQv7ViC5jVMmUxn3xT6b5YLmPAUh7er2zeyvM5m30uA6T9n6XznKv3KhpmvKkRCKcVE84gGp0Q0nGSuDxpwNep5qoJJt8UUnjDdFMORBnJT7lhPdBGdlCdDXs4NEj9V6bKVMYh8tKumaIESZcVfwiTmeZ-xUbkP28AoUQL1As40Uv27rcm4eFy_xibltXNvAg9O0730Dx-dGrxeD6UQ96prpz_DK6L7rkPNXv2QjMl9cNpBpbOGBdM9MSP-i-WUaQ12YtLBlNjgPznpo1dbghDGzrwkq2yrQdMYwKiaguZB4rlu95nQM7pdtpQjiVxfXQ4fxuWSEuZLHupNL55GvjjZBRCnqdkkUmc13JGfyZRQoHiKFWfuwxClLpn2RoZrRBO_oJ9LvKxzyc0SM7A_lSUGE-dx6W_MCDV3CEsRFymlYFaJ3aCikwS2beXe9ZUpeUN4mh2DNsBV2jT8QU8xZoOYdt7YztxTg3VoKSbGvjCBfuTG1krNEvS3g3jzoJEA0mr_d6n6svBj64BOvXE2HHcDmoswS-h5cpqmXUNoz0Tm1zgpeI1TE384eXdhSKQDXnHJ5BL6xOskvi0eVRHn1CdqGYgaLDQwVY6eLmPeNBI8RL3gz)

| | | That day, my husband was working a drug operation at a park in the Bronx -- what they call a “buy-and-bust.”After an undercover officer “bought” cocaine from a drug dealer -- a known gang member with a mile-long rap sheet -- Erik’s fellow officers moved in.The drug dealer fled, jumping on a motorcycle and taking off down a crowded sidewalk at top speed, without a helmet.When my husband spotted the drug dealer, he was barreling straight toward where two officers were arresting another suspect.Erik knew if he didn’t act quickly, someone was going to be seriously injured -- maybe even killed.So my husband made a split-second decision. He grabbed the closest thing he could find -- a small cooler --and threw it at the motorcycle to stop the drug dealer before it was too late.Erik’s quick thinking that day saved lives -- the lives of his two fellow officers and the innocent bystanders who could have been hit. But sadly, the drug dealer crashed his motorcycle and died from his injuries. When he got home that night, Erik told me he felt terrible that someone died.But I knew he did what he needed to do to keep his fellow officers safe.And I thought it was obvious to anyone with half a brain knew that this drug dealer’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own. He was the one who joined a violent street gang...He was the one who sold deadly drugs in a park where kids play...He was the one who drove a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk at top speed with no helmet on, putting himself and others in danger...But none of that mattered to the NY attorney general. **You see, Letitia James is bankrolled by George Soros. And she’s filled her office with prosecutors who hate cops as much as she does.** And five months after that fateful day......she charged Erik with Manslaughter.She didn’t just charge Erik. She and the other anti-cop activists here in New York turned the case into a media circus.They spent the next two years dragging his name through the mud and calling him a racist even though he is a proud Latino with immigrant parents.What did they expect my husband to do -- stand aside and let a drug dealer plow into the other cops with a motorcycle? Things only got worse at the trial.But not only did the judge find Erik guilty......he sentenced him to NINE YEARS in prison.The judge even told Erik he made the sentence especially tough as a “general deterrent” to other police officers!This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where the lawyers and judges in our justice system care more about “deterring” cops from doing their jobs than they do about “deterring” criminals from hurting innocent people.It makes you wonder why anyone would want to be a police officer in this day and age.But becoming a police officer in New York City was a childhood dream for Erik. He grew up in the Bronx. His family and friends still live in the area.Erik always told me how proud he was that he got to go to work every day and help get the drugs, guns and crime out of his neighborhood.And when we were getting ready for the trial, we got a flood of letters from people who lived there. Letter after letter talked about how Erik is a man with a heart for the community.But most importantly, he’s a wonderful husband and an incredible dad to our three children.Telling them their father was going to prison was the hardest thing I’ve ever done.Our five-year-old couldn’t understand.Daddy was a police officer. He was one of the good guys. Why would he go to jail?After he was sentenced, Erik was locked up in Riker’s Island in awful conditions.He spent his days in solitary confinement in a dark, filthy cell with blood all over the walls.**This is how Letitia James and Judge Guy Mitchell repaid my husband for 15 years of protecting his neighborhood.** It’s disgusting.It’s unjust.And it’s just plain wrong.Thankfully, Erik’s lawyers told us he has a good chance at an appeal. And after we filed the appeal, the court set Erik free on bond.But as you know, the appeals process is incredibly expensive.I had almost given up hope.But thank the Lord, Erik is a godly man. Through it all, his faith has never wavered -- not once.On his way home from prison, he stopped at our local church to pray and ask God for help. [**And God brought us the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=8aa8a4d609a547cfa982ff0740de225c&_e=F6bY1wAVgP1_VBcKyJ97xg-Pad1OnwSQrw9haCj-nn1Z4o-XEoCrjCByuBaqfJsWk81jfGaKo9ggKeqfh5ZfC_UplTKzAdguxVhNVwGKznbTcgTclbrBUgY93CntlwwR9LE-rD8vcihlrOfNI7PfBKzjplXCPv880Ba7brV3cXoFhTuY4eer6DZ6rToiKRkBZgo8Yf9RpOQQBIB__ph-EjAsIERBo69mSvP9eaqbZ-QBZ7VUZWObst_oFgRjw3IhniVDkM22PJ5eNHpyV-1tYrbNGirJbIoxUWYfKdoWYcRKcRtMqwAw8KNt_ZCoDyU8IO7rNeGQ_Exzh7NZsAPpBgn7PHdM5R5F-QarOs3ydj4mNO2AhSN72HrHtG76LLHoxd8uwc6ZX71NjWvAMQv7VtFPMHLerQJtsoT9m9qqbNQgD8ifH8UWolyg4rqAnxERF3sq7cewcX_DjR6EaP1HsilAdwaHWxQRHJrtVqWC13fCFVBju-uNkTU8tXqMtRdsdhDjurjmZfOX6ZoUrRJTcIdwfl9lHRwSlsTXzxAhMii99nouEB-1SiA3Bqtuk3va-xNh-P5l0k8NH0M5CKtX-_ABgidyVSTWqlVbtWmPYfmLYhjjDsJgsX0LZHouYDx5M-LbvEhDp9OrSH2cF4K3qqDO7PPfh-QGtAcC7CV1MJtnlTEILoD9vPTfAsEl6el-MS9mY89VMOClnzAcgnucVIOi1ia0xpiYKYONTQNAU02V2CEN9zHGk_PaiFqm8nYmiQldGDBpfS9dKw4iXtbbPgLGFwDMiG-kl7RGzh7RaP82gxeWj-aIBb6yecxmLFEnp7P6DfX54EZ6wfpEeEhc6dGsMniqumaIeHJ10LtosfOPsN5RzD7mZ6YYNdEr8SLGacDWmQ-WdSf9KHO7e5HVeU9HMUgWoz6Xw8ZQOc5lvzbYZTd130f9QKMPXRfrAUbLn96tf5bGqiTcChgle0n2_5YHieeAed2WIm8N48x0GEkk_5kJ8O6XV_gvGoeGzZJJ) You know that LELDF helps innocent law enforcement officers -- and their families -- fight for justice when there’s nowhere else to turn. clean_body: You’ve heard about Erik on the news. He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer. | | | | Dear Peter,I know you and I have never met. But I’m writing to you today because I’m desperate. | | | This is Erik, me, and our three children in the family photo.I wish I didn’t have to blur our faces. But with the death threats we’ve been getting, I couldn’t afford to take any chances.I should explain...You’ve heard about Erik on the news.He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer who was speeding a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk. | | | | | That day, my husband was working a drug operation at a park in the Bronx -- what they call a “buy-and-bust.”After an undercover officer “bought” cocaine from a drug dealer -- a known gang member with a mile-long rap sheet -- Erik’s fellow officers moved in.The drug dealer fled, jumping on a motorcycle and taking off down a crowded sidewalk at top speed, without a helmet.When my husband spotted the drug dealer, he was barreling straight toward where two officers were arresting another suspect.Erik knew if he didn’t act quickly, someone was going to be seriously injured -- maybe even killed.So my husband made a split-second decision. He grabbed the closest thing he could find -- a small cooler --and threw it at the motorcycle to stop the drug dealer before it was too late.Erik’s quick thinking that day saved lives -- the lives of his two fellow officers and the innocent bystanders who could have been hit. But sadly, the drug dealer crashed his motorcycle and died from his injuries. When he got home that night, Erik told me he felt terrible that someone died.But I knew he did what he needed to do to keep his fellow officers safe.And I thought it was obvious to anyone with half a brain knew that this drug dealer’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own. He was the one who joined a violent street gang...He was the one who sold deadly drugs in a park where kids play...He was the one who drove a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk at top speed with no helmet on, putting himself and others in danger...But none of that mattered to the NY attorney general. You see, Letitia James is bankrolled by George Soros. And she’s filled her office with prosecutors who hate cops as much as she does. And five months after that fateful day......she charged Erik with Manslaughter.She didn’t just charge Erik. She and the other anti-cop activists here in New York turned the case into a media circus.They spent the next two years dragging his name through the mud and calling him a racist even though he is a proud Latino with immigrant parents.What did they expect my husband to do -- stand aside and let a drug dealer plow into the other cops with a motorcycle? Things only got worse at the trial.But not only did the judge find Erik guilty......he sentenced him to NINE YEARS in prison.The judge even told Erik he made the sentence especially tough as a “general deterrent” to other police officers!This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where the lawyers and judges in our justice system care more about “deterring” cops from doing their jobs than they do about “deterring” criminals from hurting innocent people.It makes you wonder why anyone would want to be a police officer in this day and age.But becoming a police officer in New York City was a childhood dream for Erik. He grew up in the Bronx. His family and friends still live in the area.Erik always told me how proud he was that he got to go to work every day and help get the drugs, guns and crime out of his neighborhood.And when we were getting ready for the trial, we got a flood of letters from people who lived there. Letter after letter talked about how Erik is a man with a heart for the community.But most importantly, he’s a wonderful husband and an incredible dad to our three children.Telling them their father was going to prison was the hardest thing I’ve ever done.Our five-year-old couldn’t understand.Daddy was a police officer. He was one of the good guys. Why would he go to jail?After he was sentenced, Erik was locked up in Riker’s Island in awful conditions.He spent his days in solitary confinement in a dark, filthy cell with blood all over the walls.This is how Letitia James and Judge Guy Mitchell repaid my husband for 15 years of protecting his neighborhood. It’s disgusting.It’s unjust.And it’s just plain wrong.Thankfully, Erik’s lawyers told us he has a good chance at an appeal. And after we filed the appeal, the court set Erik free on bond.But as you know, the appeals process is incredibly expensive.I had almost given up hope.But thank the Lord, Erik is a godly man. Through it all, his faith has never wavered -- not once.On his way home from prison, he stopped at our local church to pray and ask God for help. You know that LELDF helps innocent law enforcement officers -- and their families -- fight for justice when there’s nowhere else to turn. Thanks to kind-hearted people like you, they get these officers the lawyers and expert witnesses they need to fight back against activist prosecutors and judges......and win.Peter, you’ve already read my email this far, so I’m going to come right out and ask: I know it’s strange to ask for your support in the very first email I’ve ever written you.But we have nowhere else to turn.Erik and I come from working-class families.We’re not wealthy.And with Erik being found guilty, we lost his salary and our medical benefits. We’re barely getting by as it is. because LELDF is a nonprofit, your gift is tax-deductible too.But whatever God is prompting you to give, please act quickly.Erik’s legal team needs to be working around the clock on this appeal.Because if we don’t fight this injustice, Erik will be imprisoned. And you know how police officers are treated in prison. And when you access the secure donation page, you’ll see there is a box where you can type a message— If you’re a believer like Erik, maybe you could write a short prayer. I know it will mean the world to him. Peter, for the past three years Erik told me something over and over again: “It’s not about the hardships. It’s about the people God sends into your life during difficult times to help you.” I pray that today you’ll be one of those people God uses to help our family.Thank you, and God bless you.Sincerely, Cynthia Duran P.S. subject: What A Night. What A Week.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
Tuesday’s victories belong to all of us. Thank you for making it possible. |
---

| | | | Today is a new day in Texas, and in Washington. And I am beside myself with gratitude and joy. First, of course, I am so grateful to all the people whose contributions have made it possible for me to **have the honor of returning to Washington for a fifth term representing Texas' Seventh Congressional District.** Every volunteer, every voter, and every member of #TeamLizzie made this victory possible. Whether you knocked on doors, made calls, contributed to the campaign, or simply read these messages and stayed engaged, you have helped make our work possible. This victory belongs to all of us. Thank you. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143182922/659356564/1008426950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjY3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODM1NDQ0ZC03OWRjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2ExYjg5NjIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lOV0GIHpYhB00zV23rxmDqMm4QxuzGvoxlNv2Sqf8l8=&emci=4c2924b9-64dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&emdi=b835444d-79dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&ceid=30230943)
---
| | **[WATCH HERE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143182923/659356565/1008426950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjY3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODM1NDQ0ZC03OWRjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2ExYjg5NjIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lOV0GIHpYhB00zV23rxmDqMm4QxuzGvoxlNv2Sqf8l8=&emci=4c2924b9-64dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&emdi=b835444d-79dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&ceid=30230943)**
---
But your work did something more than win just this election in this congressional district. Together, we changed our state and our country. Truly. Our work was a part of a much bigger effort, and an enormous victory.
**Together with people across the state and country, we did it. We turned Texas blue. We beat Texas Republicans’ unconstitutional redistricting scheme at the ballot box. **Instead of creating five new Republican seats in Texas, the map drawers and the people who forced it on Texans saw a net loss of one seat. Our Texas Democratic delegation in Congress will grow from 13 to 14. Democrats won the Texas House and won all the statewide races on the ballot. We will have a Democratic governor in Austin, a Democratic Senator in Washington, D.C.
For decades, Texas Democrats have organized, volunteered, and believed our state could choose a different path. And last Tuesday, Texans made that choice. Democrats ran on the issues Texans live with every day: costs, opportunity, and a government that answers to them. Voters across the state, from Houston to Dallas to the Rio Grande Valley, elected people who will put them first and build a better Texas for everyone.
This campaign has always been about building a coalition of people who want to ensure that our community’s core values of inclusion, innovation, and collaboration result in progress, equality, and opportunity for all Americans. Together, we have helped make those things more possible in our community, our state, and our country.
In the days since the election, I have felt the enormity of all we have accomplished. It keeps coming to me in waves about all this election will make possible. What Democrats can and will do in Austin, what we will be able to do in Washington. It is truly a new day. And it couldn’t have come a minute sooner. We need to get to work, and I am headed back to Congress to do just that.
I remain committed to doing the work every day, and to making you proud to be a part of #TeamLizzie.
Together, we can do anything,
| 3262 Westheimer, PMB 636, Houston, TX 77098
---

| | | Fellow Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Fellow Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God. For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly. That's why your support matters. It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build. | | | Now's the time to act. Now's the time to restore faith in God and faith in America before another generation drifts even farther from both. And with you, Charlie's mission will reach further -- and touch more young lives -- than ever before. For Charlie, The Turning Point USA Team P.S. Fellow Patriot, many young people leave home with a foundation of faith, only to have the culture chip away at it, piece by piece. JD Vance knows what that struggle looks like. So do countless young Americans who Turning Point USA is reaching right now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Last week's election was one for the history books. Democrats just took back the U.S. House and Senate -- and our own Nevada Democrats swept all constitutional and congressional offices that were up for election AND elected our state's first-ever Black governor!
These wins will have a tremendous impact on the direction of our state and our country and they will make life better for everyday Americans. This is huge!
And I don't want to let another second go by without saying these important words: **Thank you.** Thanks to every single one of you who donated, volunteered, and voted to make sure we elected Nevada Democrats and flipped the Senate blue to put a real check on Donald Trump.
This win doesn't belong to pundits, party insiders, or deep-pocketed billionaires. It belongs to folks like you - who gave what they could, who picked up the phone to remind their friends to vote, and who stayed in this fight when the map looked brutal and the experts told us to lower our expectations.
**Thank you for believing in Democrats ' chances BEFORE the pundits came around.**
Not long ago, a Democratic Senate majority looked like a stretch. We had to hold our own seats in states that Trump won and win in red places that hadn't gone our way in years. Plenty of people thought it couldn't be done. You decided otherwise. You kept showing up, and now we have states like Iowa, Kansas, South Carolina, and Texas sending Josh Turek, Adam Hamilton, Annie Andrews, and James Talarico to Washington. We're also in a strong position to flip Alaska and Mississippi, sending Mary Peltola and Scott Colom to the Senate.
**Thank you for speaking out and giving what you can, even when times are tight.**
Whether you knocked on doors or made phone calls, attended protests and rallies, wrote letters, signed petitions, donated to campaigns you care about, or told your friends to remember to vote, every effort made a difference.
**Thank you for caring about Nevada 's future.**
Every statewide constitutional office in Nevada went blue. We elected our first-ever Black governor in Aaron Ford. We elected the first Democrat to ever win a historically red district, NV-02. We secured a supermajority in the state Assembly and a strong majority in the state Senate. These state-level wins might not always get national headlines, but they matter for real people every day. Now, Nevada Democrats can get to work lowering costs and prioritizing the needs of working families.
**Thank you for being part of this team.**
We showed that there is strength in numbers, and we showed a handful of billionaires that our elections are not for sale.
This was our last best chance to put a check on the Trump administration, and together, we seized it.
**Now, the real work begins.**
That means doing everything we can to deliver for families facing rising costs and backing the small businesses in Nevada and across the country that keep our communities running. It means holding Trump administration officials accountable, restoring health care access for millions, and showing people that government can work for them again, even after Trump's chaos and corruption.
Change won't happen overnight, and I'll keep being straight with you about the challenges ahead. But for the first time in a long while, we have the chance to do it, and you gave us that chance.
Thank you for everything. I'm so grateful to be on this team with you.
Jacky
* * *
##### `A personal note from Sen. Jacky Rosen:`
##### `My work in the Senate has always been defined by who I am and where I come from. Growing up as the granddaughter of immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, my family instilled in me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence at a young age.`
##### `Now, I'm proud to fight tirelessly in the Senate to deliver progress for hardworking families like mine in Nevada and across our country. But with Donald Trump in the White House and Republicans in control of both houses of Congress, I need your grassroots support to keep up the fights that matter most.`
##### `Senate Democrats like me are the only thing standing in the way of Trump's extreme agenda that will hurt everyday Americans. That's why I need people like you on my side to help defend our progress and reclaim power from the GOP.`
##### `If you're with me, will you chip in now to help Democrats win Nevada and keep the Senate blue?`

It belongs to folks like you - who gave what they could, who picked up the phone to remind their friends to vote, and who stayed in this fight when the map looked brutal and the experts told us to lower our expectations. Thank you for believing in Democrats ' chances BEFORE the pundits came around. Not long ago, a Democratic Senate majority looked like a stretch. We had to hold our own seats in states that Trump won and win in red places that hadn't gone our way in years. Plenty of people thought it couldn't be done. You decided otherwise. You kept showing up, and now we have states like Iowa, Kansas, South Carolina, and Texas sending Josh Turek, Adam Hamilton, Annie Andrews, and James Talarico to Washington. We're also in a strong position to flip Alaska and Mississippi, sending Mary Peltola and Scott Colom to the Senate. Thank you for speaking out and giving what you can, even when times are tight. Whether you knocked on doors or made phone calls, attended protests and rallies, wrote letters, signed petitions, donated to campaigns you care about, or told your friends to remember to vote, every effort made a difference. Thank you for caring about Nevada 's future. Every statewide constitutional office in Nevada went blue. We elected our first-ever Black governor in Aaron Ford. We elected the first Democrat to ever win a historically red district, NV-02. We secured a supermajority in the state Assembly and a strong majority in the state Senate. These state-level wins might not always get national headlines, but they matter for real people every day. Now, Nevada Democrats can get to work lowering costs and prioritizing the needs of working families. Thank you for being part of this team. We showed that there is strength in numbers, and we showed a handful of billionaires that our elections are not for sale. This was our last best chance to put a check on the Trump administration, and together, we seized it. Now, the real work begins. That means doing everything we can to deliver for families facing rising costs and backing the small businesses in Nevada and across the country that keep our communities running. It means holding Trump administration officials accountable, restoring health care access for millions, and showing people that government can work for them again, even after Trump's chaos and corruption. Change won't happen overnight, and I'll keep being straight with you about the challenges ahead. But for the first time in a long while, we have the chance to do it, and you gave us that chance. Thank you for everything. I'm so grateful to be on this team with you. Jacky * `A personal note from Sen. Jacky Rosen:` `My work in the Senate has always been defined by who I am and where I come from. Growing up as the granddaughter of immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran, my family instilled in me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence at a young age.` `Now, I'm proud to fight tirelessly in the Senate to deliver progress for hardworking families like mine in Nevada and across our country. But with Donald Trump in the White House and Republicans in control of both houses of Congress, I need your grassroots support to keep up the fights that matter most.` `Senate Democrats like me are the only thing standing in the way of Trump's extreme agenda that will hurt everyday Americans. That's why I need people like you on my side to help defend our progress and reclaim power from the GOP.` `If you're with me, will you chip in now to help Democrats win Nevada and keep the Senate blue?` Paid for by Jacky Rosen for Nevada. subject: The Senate is blue – thanks to you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada Rosen for Nevada
body:
Now, it’s up to us to deliver.
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143184710/659362987/-1975233963?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5938-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDMxMWYzOC04MWRjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2ExYjg5NjIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uFVTN5LnoLUsrWGDaAY22K4PJJ1GaPpxVPPS1CZGNbI=)
---
Friend, we did it. Last week’s election results were history-making.
There are still Senate races that are too close to call in Mississippi and Alaska, but come January, **we’re going to have a blue Senate.**
In Nevada, Democrats won all constitutional and congressional offices. We elected Teresa Benitez Thompson to Congress, winning the U.S. House district in Northern Nevada for the first time in its existence. We elected our first-ever Black governor in state history, Aaron Ford. We secured a supermajority in the state Assembly and a strong majority in the state Senate — meaning Nevada’s state government can get to work bringing down costs and making every day better for working families.
So I had to reach out to thank the people who made that happen: YOU.
At the start of this election cycle, Donald Trump had just retaken office, and political forecasters said there was almost no chance of a Democratic Senate.
Few thought we’d be able to compete in states like Iowa, Kansas, South Carolina, and Texas, let alone WIN!
And we have you to thank for that.
**Thank you for believing in us.** Donald Trump and Republicans wanted us to be cynical and apathetic, but you showed up with heart and determination to help undo the chaos and corruption this administration has sowed.
**Thank you for speaking out.** Whether you knocked on doors, attended protests and rallies, wrote letters, signed petitions, donated to campaigns you care about, or told your friends to remember to vote, every effort made a difference.
**Thank you for being part of this team.** We showed that there is strength in numbers, and we showed a handful of billionaires that our elections are not for sale.
This was our last best chance to put a check on the Trump administration, and together, we seized it.
Now, the real work begins. That means doing everything we can to deliver for families facing rising costs and backing the small businesses in Nevada and across the country that keep our communities running. It means holding Trump administration officials accountable, restoring health care access for millions, and showing people that government can work for them again, even after Trump’s chaos and corruption.
Voters are demanding change, and Democrats are ready to deliver it. I can’t wait to see what we accomplish together.
With endless gratitude,
Jacky

subject: We Want To Hear From You
body:
Last Tuesday was a tough night for conservatives. Take our 3-minute survey and tell us what comes next
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org/1/010001a1c2371632-de8797a0-cb81-4803-bc4f-d4dd5fabdf91-000000/JQDWS6jOpbVzzGUYC743S0AYStldbExxkzrs5FsyFww=452)Patriot–**Tuesday was a tough night for conservatives**.I’m not going to pretend otherwise, and I’m not going to tell you how to feel about it. Before Tea Party Patriots Action decides what comes next, I want to hear it straight from you.You are the reason this movement exists. You make the calls, write the postcards, knock the doors, and show up when it counts. You have a say in where we go from here.We’ve put together a short [_Post-Election Supporter Survey_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLSeBmlcLhgHkm5PNT-SlI3M8co5jybGnsEvhlXXGtLHMmbCVww%2Fviewform/1/010001a1c2371632-de8797a0-cb81-4803-bc4f-d4dd5fabdf91-000000/ayhtkN4nK-91Wyl7vtJAId0B6UHLeC5JSofaLyaP_KA=452), and your answers go straight into our planning for the next two years.We want to know:
* **How you’re feeling about staying involved**
* **What you think went wrong, and what conservatives should do differently before 2028**
* **What Tea Party Patriots Action could do better**
* **Which issues you want us to fight for most**

The first part takes about 3 minutes. At the end, you can choose to answer more questions if you have more to say. There’s even room to write out your specific costs.[COMPLETE MY SURVEY](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fdocs.google.com%2Fforms%2Fd%2Fe%2F1FAIpQLSeBmlcLhgHkm5PNT-SlI3M8co5jybGnsEvhlXXGtLHMmbCVww%2Fviewform/2/010001a1c2371632-de8797a0-cb81-4803-bc4f-d4dd5fabdf91-000000/kCrtCaFwNL9zJhMPX-A9TU18nKpWPym9OYHOd4BmAz0=452)We’re listening, and what you tell us will shape how we use our time, our voice, and our resources.Please take a few minutes today. name: Team Kaptur
subject: We're not waiting
body:
This is what we've learned over the years

| |
---
Friend, Last week, Northwest Ohio sent Marcy back to Congress, and Democrats took back the House. We're still catching our breath here, and we're grateful to everyone who made it happen. We've also learned something over the last few cycles. The special interests that come after this seat never really go away. They spent millions trying to beat Marcy this year, and they'll spend the next two years getting ready to try again. So we're not waiting. We can't afford to. Here's what happened last Tuesday:
* **In Georgia, EMILYs List-endorsed Keisha Lance Bottoms flipped the governor's office, and EMILYs List women helped Democrats take control of the state House.** Two more EMILYs List women, Tanya Miller and Judge Penny Brown Reynolds, were elected attorney general and secretary of state, respectively — fundamentally shifting the balance of power in a state with a draconian abortion ban.

* **In Texas, EMILYs List-endorsed Gina Hinojosa defeated Greg Abbott, becoming the state's first Democratic governor in more than 30 years.** Democrats also flipped the state House, bringing Texas one step closer to restoring the right to choose in the Lone Star State.

* **EMILYs List women made historic gains on state Supreme Courts,** sweeping all FOUR contested seats in Texas and winning both races in Ohio — electing women with a history of standing up for fundamental rights.

* And across the country, EMILYs List women broke Republican trifectas in four states and gained full control of state government in SIX — Arizona, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. **These historic victories** will create new opportunities to strengthen abortion protections, expand access to care, and dismantle remaining restrictions.

Meanwhile, voters in Virginia and Nevada approved constitutional protections for abortion rights, and Missouri voters rejected an attempt to reinstate an abortion ban.
**The message couldn't be clearer: Reproductive freedom is a winning issue, and voters are demanding leaders who will defend it.**
But our work is far from finished. Millions of Americans still live under restrictive abortion bans, and **the fight to restore reproductive freedom continues.**
In 2028, we have an opportunity to build on Tuesday's victories — flipping more state legislative chambers and electing more Democratic pro-choice women at every level who will turn this momentum into lasting change.

clean_body: Voters sent a clear message about reproductive freedom | = Hi Peter, it's Emily Parés, deputy chief campaigns officer for state and local campaigns at EMILYs List. I've spent my career working to elect Democratic pro-choice women to state and local office, and I can tell you this: Tuesday's election was a watershed moment for reproductive freedom in America. Just under a week ago, voters cast their votes and delivered a once-in-a-generation blue wave up and down the ballot. Across the country, voters rejected anti-choice extremism and elected leaders who will fight to protect their fundamental freedoms. And the implications for abortion rights could be enormous. = | = Here's what happened last Tuesday: In Georgia, EMILYs List-endorsed Keisha Lance Bottoms flipped the governor's office, and EMILYs List women helped Democrats take control of the state House. Two more EMILYs List women, Tanya Miller and Judge Penny Brown Reynolds, were elected attorney general and secretary of state, respectively — fundamentally shifting the balance of power in a state with a draconian abortion ban. In Texas, EMILYs List-endorsed Gina Hinojosa defeated Greg Abbott, becoming the state's first Democratic governor in more than 30 years. Democrats also flipped the state House, bringing Texas one step closer to restoring the right to choose in the Lone Star State. EMILYs List women made historic gains on state Supreme Courts, sweeping all FOUR contested seats in Texas and winning both races in Ohio — electing women with a history of standing up for fundamental rights. And across the country, EMILYs List women broke Republican trifectas in four states and gained full control of state government in SIX — Arizona, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. These historic victories will create new opportunities to strengthen abortion protections, expand access to care, and dismantle remaining restrictions. Meanwhile, voters in Virginia and Nevada approved constitutional protections for abortion rights, and Missouri voters rejected an attempt to reinstate an abortion ban. The message couldn't be clearer: Reproductive freedom is a winning issue, and voters are demanding leaders who will defend it. But our work is far from finished. Millions of Americans still live under restrictive abortion bans, and the fight to restore reproductive freedom continues. In 2028, we have an opportunity to build on Tuesday's victories — flipping more state legislative chambers and electing more Democratic pro-choice women at every level who will turn this momentum into lasting change. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you, Emily Parés (she/her/hers) Deputy Chief Campaigns Officer, State & Local Campaigns, EMILYs List | = | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. Friend, This letter couldn't wait.That's why Kirk Cameron personally asked me to write you on the post-production budget shortfall for "Iggy and Mr. Kirk." He wanted to make sure you heard about this urgent situation as soon as possible.**And after you hear what's going on, I hope you'll support BRAVE FOR GOOD.** **[We are facing a serious budget shortfall of $48,523.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=32297834938e4567bf23807f7f0c78a6&_e=e5wGtcP3Uv6h4HjVulLbiyLYjsNXLELolYN3f29nZIs_b5Xz76WH_qoNVvVj5Nufrv_vzFJrj_9HadKjEc1Kqx_CuGbkvw7STGeA9whRh181nvEVkM9gZePM1hc7xmbNQPs1bQzY_gcOoUxW5pbZATI96pr2X_6rcTJFmEf24VJRCNXXvyt2f_P_fcA-Zl3KyeGSf_QlhHJOKGOp54ktB_hcNlM5JJrtd5HPwmPxRLYKvEZtFI1l_odfxZ-Wj8lbjMjgV56D7LLi0kj7nQteIo3xhNvZJa0xBj4-Wqlgm1SyB-wtYvNnkNOiGczORL7M_BIMXPjKk_jSomSR5ZkYjJgmASlIM_Lb-pcO7AhuznMt9hDhL82oIwH1zyjm9L4RT81_omgX6JwbJOY41qFIQUyoLQ8HyzXS5B2KsuqIU_s-iyDyg-i1RoH1BGTVEB1Xxy4AZC8662wslta8SKubeCUMa5WNk-DlFYhS-jfJCkzMtWiO4P_KS3jxrNnBtzhW)** But before I go into more detail, let me tell you a little about our mission to help parents instill wholesome and Godly values in America's children. Kirk just wrapped up this year's "See You at the Library Day," where we countered the Left and brought conservative values straight to America's children.Kirk is busy spearheading the "Bible Revival" movement that gets Biblical values -- that America was founded upon -- back into schools. And Kirk just finished filming Season 3 of our television show "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" that teaches children how to respond to the deceitful culture with Biblical values and steadfast faith.**I'm writing you with such urgency because Season 3 of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" is in jeopardy.** **[And if I can't raise $48,523 in the next four weeks, "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" will be delayed -- or even postponed indefinitely.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=32297834938e4567bf23807f7f0c78a6&_e=e5wGtcP3Uv6h4HjVulLbiyLYjsNXLELolYN3f29nZIs_b5Xz76WH_qoNVvVj5Nufrv_vzFJrj_9HadKjEc1Kqx_CuGbkvw7STGeA9whRh181nvEVkM9gZePM1hc7xmbNQPs1bQzY_gcOoUxW5pbZATI96pr2X_6rcTJFmEf24VJRCNXXvyt2f_P_fcA-Zl3KyeGSf_QlhHJOKGOp54ktB_hcNlM5JJrtd5HPwmPxRLYKvEZtFI1l_odfxZ-Wj8lbjMjgV56D7LLi0kj7nQteIo3xhNvZJa0xBj4-Wqlgm1SyB-wtYvNnkNOiGczORL7M_BIMXPjKk_jSomSR5ZkYjNjIARn2jxaZjzy7jcobx7Pig_hBKRWqeWaObYwjtu3RC9rLox63is-552ZQcIJbC9FFah5_y3iwGzKuYKxWgsgJhNbyW1PmMUDwEME11UGeA2FwgmgzKfUhuAwBZxLL0HvPq4EFUe29rHL92Bi3TlZ2Cggtida7NwhQsIcaLBIA)** The radical Leftists who attack us because we're reaching America's children with God's Truth would love nothing more than to see "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" shut down.They hate that "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" has skyrocketed to the top of Angel Studios' streaming service. They hate that we've created a path around the addictive mind rot they put on TV.It's like Kirk always says... It's not enough to complain about culture raising our children. We must create something better for them. The first 2 seasons of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" have reached millions of children and counting, but Season 3 is in jeopardy.If "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" isn't funded, there will be no voice on TV countering the Left's dangerous lies.Lies like Drag Queens leading a Pride Parade SingAlong on Blue's Clues...Same-sex weddings on Arthur... And Sesame Street using YOUR tax dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And that's just what's on TV. Not to mention the thousands of 'Queer Kid' videos on platforms like YouTube Kids.The days of The Andy Griffith Show and Father Knows Best are gone. The Left has purposely used TV to create a generation of zombie children who are glued to their screens."Iggy and Mr. Kirk" is the antidote to that Leftist TV brainwashing.It uses low-stimulation production and teaches children how to respond to the deceitful culture with Biblical values and steadfast faith. Like when Mr. Kirk teaches Iggy:
---
* to love how God created him as an iguana, even when the villainous Culture the Vulture says Iggy must become a human to fit in.
* to rely on the wisdom of parents -- one mom and one dad -- to solve life's problems.
* to be BRAVE by speaking truth in the face of the Left's lies.

---

Fellow Patriot, please help. Because this is so urgent, I wanted to reach out to Americans who share our concern for the next generation.On behalf of myself, Kirk, and our entire team, thank you for considering supporting BRAVE FOR GOOD. Together, we will rebuild a culture that honors God and His will for our lives.

Sincerely, Dr. Trent TalbotFounder, BRAVE for Good

The courts
are supposed to belong to the people. Not Trump. Not his billionaire
backers. Not the corporations bankrolling his allies.

But right now, our courts are corrupt and rigged for the powerful. Trump
is stacking the bench with cronies who rule for him and him alone. And the
Senate keeps voting yes on his nominees.

Every yes vote locks in his authoritarian grip on the judiciary for
decades.

That’s why Demand Justice PAC exists: to root out corruption from our
courts and fight for a judiciary that is independent and serves all of us.

Last week, voters across the country chose leaders who will stand up for
our courts, including by expanding the Supreme Court to protect the people
and restore its independence. And they voted Republicans out of the Senate
majority.

Trump and the GOP got the message. Now they’re scrambling.

Between now and January 3rd, when the new Congress is sworn in, they’ll do
everything in their power to install as many loyalists as possible before
they lose control of the Senate. And every judge confirmed in the next two
months could sit on the bench for life.

We have to carry last week’s momentum all the way to January. That means
putting relentless pressure on senators to vote NO on every Trump nominee,
and making sure voters know exactly which senators are handing Trump more
loyalists.

The thesaurus can only get you so far: bloodbath, wipeout, disaster, catastrophe, extinction-level event. Figurative expressions get closer: Harikari for the GOP consultant class, you should never work in politics again, the commissions you made this cycle were basically theft, this is more embarrassing than that time the Dexter Tigers helped Traip Academy's football team snap* a four-year losing streak.
Well, I guess those aren't that figurative, but you get my point. It's going to take some work to convey just how terrible, no good, and very bad the 2026 election was for conservatives in Maine (using the election win percentage of the Maine Republican Party as an imperfect proxy for what's harmful versus beneficial for conservatives). Even as some national observers point up that the blue shift here was less severe than in other states, the state level Republican effort shocked even the most pessimistic prognosticators.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..1KmeGp9d79aF8YMarofnmq_9EYuKNaRYdrcalGPvZAY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=224148480)
Susan Collins, a five-term incumbent who ran 14 points ahead of her polling average in 2020, lost to Troy Jackson by roughly 44,500 votes. That's equivalent to the entire population of Bangor and Brewer combined, plus Dexter. Or nearly the entire population of Franklin and Piscataquis counties combined. This, from a legendary Maine Republican who won her previous elections by 22.7%, 36.9%, and 8.6%. And she was running against a guy whose own party doesn't even like him! Just a few month ago, Jackson finished third in the gubernatorial primary with 21.1% of the vote. So the most durable Republican brand Maine has produced in a generation went down to the unlikeable, semi-literate, scandal-plagued replacement of an alleged rapist with a Nazi tattoo.
The governor's race was over as soon as the GOP primary count ended, and every honest Republican will admit it.
Bobby Charles' ChatGPT memes and hard-lean into my reporting on Gateway Community Services won him the favor of Facebook-hooked baby boomers who voted with nary a thought of general election viability. As a primary candidate, Charles portrayed himself as the Trumpiest MAGA Man in the room.
"I love President Trump" and "I am totally on side with what he's doing without apology," he said in Oct. 2025, while claiming to have written more than 500 articles praising and supporting Trump.
Predictably, the general election required a different kind of messaging. "I do not know President Trump. I have never met him," Charles would later say. "A governor can disagree with the president," he said, promising to be an "independent voice to confront the president." MAGA nods disappeared from his website. But the hard pro-Trump line Charles took in order to win the GOP primary was difficult to walk back as he tried to woo voters who overwhelmingly disapproved of Trump's job performance.
Who could have seen that dynamic coming!?!
The Charles camp ran a strategy that depended on intentionally elevating Bennett. Indeed, voters heard more about Bennett from Charles' social media team than they did from Bennett! Now they'd like claim his spoiler effect caused Charles to underperform Paul LePage's 2022 performance against Gov. Janet Mills by about 5%. Go ahead and add Bennett's 57,478 votes to Charles's total and you get 323,460, which still leaves Pingree 63,766 votes ahead. On these unofficial totals she'd have beaten the entire non-Pingree vote in a two-way race. The spoiler explanation is false.
In the 1st District, Ron Russell ran a heroic yet Sisyphean race against Rep. Chellie Pingree, who, despite having adopted Trump's exact hair style and doing virtually nothing of importance, remains an automatic checkmark for the coastal elite.
That's a 32-point district. When you consider the narrowness of LePage's victory in the 2nd District, the challenge for conservatives becomes clear. For both Collins and Charles, the path to winning statewide was always going to be boosting the rural CD-2 turnout to offset the urban leftists in CD-1. That didn't come close to happening. What's more, it might have been a doomed-from-the-start decision because it caused the Maine GOP to not even contest many CD-1 legislative races. The lack of a candidate in those districts translated into a lack of boots-on-the-ground, and it also allowed Democratic leaders to tell voters in those areas: "Hey, the GOP doesn't even care enough about you to run a candidate here." A statewide Republican strategy that writes off the 1st District is a plan to keep losing.
The only glimmer of good news for Republicans nationally is, upon closer examination, still a massive indictment of the Republican Party apparatus. In the 2nd Congressional District, the Secretary of State's first-choice totals have LePage at 170,263 and Matt Dunlap at 164,845 out of 341,248 ballots, a lead of 5,418. A win's a win, for sure, but that's also a sub-two-percent win in a district that Trump carried by nine points in 2024, 7.4 points in 2020, and 10.3 points in 2016. LePage is easily the most successful and influential conservative Maine has experienced in the modern political era, but there's a case to be made this race wouldn't have been close if Rep. Jared Golden eschewed early retirement, or if Dunlap wasn't so dweebish or hadn't been effectively shunned by DC's Democrat establishment.
Comparing the House Districts to prior years is where the collapse of the Republican Party's ability to turnout voters really becomes apparent. Across 150 contested, called races, the Republican margin ran a median 3.2 points behind Trump's 2024 margin in the same district. Senate candidates ran a median 4.0 points behind (30 races), and House candidates ran 2.9 behind (120 races). Three points doesn't sound like much until you apply it to a map full of seats Trump carried by 2 to 8 points.
On the called races, House Democrats sit at 86 seats to the Republicans' 59, with 3 independents (who are all the Angus King / Bernie Sanders-style leftists who just fake being "independent"). The Senate is 24 to 11. Seven of the 15 flips came in districts Trump carried.
**Here's every Trump district Republicans lost,** starting with the six House seats Democrats won in districts Trump carried by more than half a point (towns from the Legislature's [district list](https://substack.com/redirect/6298d74c-8216-45ca-bdcb-92c2d7b5efa3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), margins and vote totals from MultiState):
* **HD-143, Sanford (part).** Trump +12.5. Democrat John R. Henkelman beat Republican Melissa A. Simpson 2,066 to 1,711, or 54.7% to 45.3%. Losing by 9.4 in a Trump +12.5 district is a 21.9-point underperformance, the worst contested gap in the table.
* **HD-137, Buxton (part) and Hollis (part).** Trump +8.0. Democrat Charles Tilburg beat Republican Rep. Nathan Carlow 2,590 to 2,469, or 51.2% to 48.8%.
* **HD-148, Berwick and North Berwick (part).** Trump +6.8. Democrat Marissa L. Tasker beat Republican Rep. Thomas Lavigne 2,377 to 2,248, or 51.4% to 48.6%.
* **HD-52, Bowdoinham, Richmond, Bowdoin (part) and Perkins Island Township.** Trump +4.0. Democratic Rep. Sally Cluchey beat Republican David Guilmette 2,651 to 2,327, or 53.3% to 46.7%.
* **HD-82, Fryeburg, Brownfield, Hiram, Lovell and Porter.** Trump +2.4. Democrat Chris Lewey beat Republican Caleb Ness 2,453 to 2,344, or 51.1% to 48.9%.
* **HD-20, Brewer (part).** Trump +0.6. Democratic Rep. Dani O'Halloran beat Republican Patrick Jude 2,384 to 1,879, or 55.9% to 44.1%.
* **SD-15, Augusta, Belgrade, China, Mount Vernon, Sidney and Vassalboro.** Trump +3.3. Democrat Amanda Heath beat Republican Kati McCormick 52.0% to 48.0%, flipping a Republican-held seat.
* **HD-45, Bremen, Friendship, Waldoboro and Washington.** Trump +7.0. Independent Clinton Collamore beat Republican Rebecca Stephens 51.8% to 48.2%, flipping a Republican-held seat.
* **HD-44, Hope, Union and Warren.** Trump +5.7. Independent Shawn Saindon beat Republican Ray Thombs, retaining independent control of the seat.
* **HD-58, Belgrade, Fayette, Mount Vernon, New Sharon, Rome and Vienna.** Trump +8.0. Independent Rep. Sharon Frost beat Republican Dexter "Buzz" Bridges Jr. 3,063 to 2,506, or 55.0% to 45.0%.
* **HD-83, Bridgton, Denmark and Harrison.** Trump +0.5. Democrat Timothy J. Becker beat Republican Rep. Marygrace Cimino.
* **HD-86, Casco, Frye Island, Raymond and Poland (part).** Trump +1.5. Democrat Abigail Geer defeated Republican Rep. Rolf Olsen by approximately 56 votes, flipping a Republican-held seat.

Also worth noting: outgoing Rep. Laurel Libby's open seat, HD-90, was a Harris +0.9 district, which is about as close to a coin flip as a district gets, and Democrat Pamela Hart won it by 15.8 points. The highest-profile Republican in the House left behind a seat her party couldn't keep close.
Incumbency didn't help either, at least not for Republicans. As of this writing, ten incumbents fell last week, and all nine are Republicans: Sens. Scott Cyrway and Bruce Bickford, and Reps. Peter Wood, Marygrace Cimino, Quentin Chapman, Barbara Bagshaw, Mark Cooper, Nathan Carlow, Rolf Olsen, and Thomas Lavigne. No Democratic incumbent has a called loss.
Money wasn't the sole determinant either. Here's a look at how campaign spending (including spending not directly from a candidate's committee) in those Trump districts broke out.

Jared Golden eschewed early retirement, or if Dunlap wasn't so dweebish or hadn't been effectively shunned by DC's Democrat establishment. Comparing the House Districts to prior years is where the collapse of the Republican Party's ability to turnout voters really becomes apparent. Across 150 contested, called races, the Republican margin ran a median 3.2 points behind Trump's 2024 margin in the same district. Senate candidates ran a median 4.0 points behind (30 races), and House candidates ran 2.9 behind (120 races). Three points doesn't sound like much until you apply it to a map full of seats Trump carried by 2 to 8 points. On the called races, House Democrats sit at 86 seats to the Republicans' 59, with 3 independents (who are all the Angus King / Bernie Sanders-style leftists who just fake being "independent"). The Senate is 24 to 11. Seven of the 15 flips came in districts Trump carried. Here's every Trump district Republicans lost, starting with the six House seats Democrats won in districts Trump carried by more than half a point (towns from the Legislature's , margins and vote totals from MultiState): HD-143, Sanford (part). Trump +12.5. Democrat John R. Henkelman beat Republican Melissa A. Simpson 2,066 to 1,711, or 54.7% to 45.3%. Losing by 9.4 in a Trump +12.5 district is a 21.9-point underperformance, the worst contested gap in the table. HD-137, Buxton (part) and Hollis (part). Trump +8.0. Democrat Charles Tilburg beat Republican Rep. Nathan Carlow 2,590 to 2,469, or 51.2% to 48.8%. HD-148, Berwick and North Berwick (part). Trump +6.8. Democrat Marissa L. Tasker beat Republican Rep. Thomas Lavigne 2,377 to 2,248, or 51.4% to 48.6%. HD-52, Bowdoinham, Richmond, Bowdoin (part) and Perkins Island Township. Trump +4.0. Democratic Rep. Sally Cluchey beat Republican David Guilmette 2,651 to 2,327, or 53.3% to 46.7%. HD-82, Fryeburg, Brownfield, Hiram, Lovell and Porter. Trump +2.4. Democrat Chris Lewey beat Republican Caleb Ness 2,453 to 2,344, or 51.1% to 48.9%. HD-20, Brewer (part). Trump +0.6. Democratic Rep. Dani O'Halloran beat Republican Patrick Jude 2,384 to 1,879, or 55.9% to 44.1%. SD-15, Augusta, Belgrade, China, Mount Vernon, Sidney and Vassalboro. Trump +3.3. Democrat Amanda Heath beat Republican Kati McCormick 52.0% to 48.0%, flipping a Republican-held seat. HD-45, Bremen, Friendship, Waldoboro and Washington. Trump +7.0. Independent Clinton Collamore beat Republican Rebecca Stephens 51.8% to 48.2%, flipping a Republican-held seat. HD-44, Hope, Union and Warren. Trump +5.7. Independent Shawn Saindon beat Republican Ray Thombs, retaining independent control of the seat. HD-58, Belgrade, Fayette, Mount Vernon, New Sharon, Rome and Vienna. Trump +8.0. Independent Rep. Sharon Frost beat Republican Dexter "Buzz" Bridges Jr. 3,063 to 2,506, or 55.0% to 45.0%. HD-83, Bridgton, Denmark and Harrison. Trump +0.5. Democrat Timothy J. Becker beat Republican Rep. Marygrace Cimino. HD-86, Casco, Frye Island, Raymond and Poland (part). Trump +1.5. Democrat Abigail Geer defeated Republican Rep. Rolf Olsen by approximately 56 votes, flipping a Republican-held seat. Also worth noting: outgoing Rep. Laurel Libby's open seat, HD-90, was a Harris +0.9 district, which is about as close to a coin flip as a district gets, and Democrat Pamela Hart won it by 15.8 points. The highest-profile Republican in the House left behind a seat her party couldn't keep close. Incumbency didn't help either, at least not for Republicans. As of this writing, ten incumbents fell last week, and all nine are Republicans: Sens. Scott Cyrway and Bruce Bickford, and Reps. Peter Wood, Marygrace Cimino, Quentin Chapman, Barbara Bagshaw, Mark Cooper, Nathan Carlow, Rolf Olsen, and Thomas Lavigne. No Democratic incumbent has a called loss. Money wasn't the sole determinant either. body:
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

| | | |
---
| | | Friend,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

clean_body: Faith is essential to the survival and success of America. | | | | | | | Friend, Faith is essential to the survival and success of America. Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth. He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him. He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country. That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt. That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith. Friend, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story... It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now. So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God. For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly. That's why your support matters. It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build. | | | Now's the time to act. Now's the time to restore faith in God and faith in America before another generation drifts even farther from both. And with you, Charlie's mission will reach further -- and touch more young lives -- than ever before. For Charlie, The Turning Point USA Team P.S. | | **Eileen Laubacher Declares Historic Victory in Colorado’s 4th Congressional District** _Retired Rear Admiral defeats incumbent Lauren Boebert, pledges to put service above politics and deliver results for Colorado families_
---
| | “I’m honored by the trust the people of Colorado’s 4th District have placed in me. This campaign was never about party labels. It was about putting people first.“Over 17 months, I traveled 40,000 miles across all 21 counties. The message was clear: Coloradans are tired of political games, broken promises, and being ignored by Washington. They want someone who will fight for them and deliver results.“The problems facing American families haven’t changed. Grocery prices are still too high, healthcare remains unaffordable for too many, and the war in Iran continues. Those challenges remain, and the work starts now.”“I spent 34 years in the Navy putting mission before politics. That’s exactly what I’ll do in Congress. I don’t answer to a political party. I answer to the people of the 4th district and I’ll work with anyone and everyone, including President Trump, Republicans, and Democrats to get things done for Colorado.”
“This victory is historic. But making history means nothing if we don’t make a difference. My focus is simple: lower costs, protect healthcare, strengthen rural communities, take on corruption in both parties, and hold Washington accountable.”
“To those who voted for me, thank you, I will strive to make you proud. To those who didn’t, I’ll fight just as hard for you and hope to earn your support.”
“We made history. Now let’s make a difference.”
**###**

On October 28, Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty announced FELONY
CHARGES AGAINST ME in Minnesota for unlawful voting and identity
theft. Together, the two counts carry up to 10 YEARS IN PRISON AND
$20,000 IN FINES.

At the same press conference, she said this:

“I think it's pretty clear they did not intend to vote.”

And then: “WHETHER OR NOT THEY INTENDED TO VOTE IS IRRELEVANT.”

I'm writing to you because I need help, and I need it fast.

On August 11, the day of Minnesota's primary, my team took hidden
cameras into Minneapolis polling places to document how the state's
voter “vouching” law works. Under that law, a registered voter can
vouch for up to eight people who show up to register without the usual
proof of address.

Election workers explained it to us on camera. One said: “YOU'RE THE
ID.”

Then we left. WE NEVER SIGNED AN OATH. WE NEVER RECEIVED A BALLOT. WE
NEVER VOTED. The prosecutor agrees we “stopped short of signing the
oath.”

[Stand with James. Donate now.]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Her case is that answering an election judge's questions was the start
of “a multi-step process” of applying for a ballot, an idea the
complaint pulls from the Secretary of State's election manual.

Testing whether a system can be abused is not the same as abusing it.

She called it “A LOW LEVEL OFFENSE.” And she still held a press
conference about it six days before a national election.

[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

She also said: “THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS UNDERCOVER INVESTIGATION
IN THE POLLING PLACE.”

I've been sued more times than I can count. Police once walked into my
newsroom and took my guns. One case took me NINE YEARS to win, all the
way to a federal appeals court.

Every time, the goal is the same. If they can't beat the footage, they
try to bury the reporter in court.

This time it isn't money on the line. It's a felony record.

A felony defense in another state means Minnesota lawyers, travel for
every court date, motions, transcripts, and maybe a trial. And every
hour I spend in a courtroom is an hour I'm not in the field.

Friend, Now that the dust has settled a bit, I wanted to send one more thank you. I've been thinking back on everything it took to get here. The summer days knocking doors in the heat. The phone and text banks. The union halls, the community events, and the kitchen-table conversations across this district. And behind all of it, supporters like you, who gave what you could, sometimes more than once, because you believed North Jersey deserved a representative who would fight for all families. I don't take that for granted. I'm heading back to what will be a new Washington ready to keep working on what I heard most on the campaign trail: bringing down costs, protecting our communities, and delivering federal resources home to North Jersey. Peter,

In the face of an unprecedented federal investigation against her driven
by Trump, Ilhan pulled off her biggest electoral win since 2018 on
Tuesday.

Her victory came less than a month after Trump’s DHS agents raided her
home in an attempt to intimidate her before Election Day. As Trump and his
administration scrambled to weaponize every level of federal power to
silence her, voters showed up — proving that people power will always come
out on top against authoritarianism.

But make no mistake,
Peter: Trump’s racist attacks

smears, and the recent plot to illegally strip away her citizenship pushed

Post-Election Update!

We did it!

We planned. We put our plans into action. And we won!
Oh my goodness, did we win! Up and down the ballot, from the east coast to the west coast and all the places in between. There are some races that are still too close to call, but all signs are pointing to even more Ws for Team Blue up ahead.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143188026/659374817/468628139?refcode=jtk1333-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzYxODI3ZC05NWRjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2ExYjg5NjIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sVl5hspxUCnY45FSdMAMUamtgL0bsNvDhtVqlgC3aCQ=&emci=5b7485a2-74dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&emdi=9761827d-95dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&ceid=21278485)
And as excited – truly jumping for joy – as I am for all these races, I’m most excited about Chrissy’s re-election. With 99% of the vote counted in PA-06, Chrissy had a decisive victory and earned more than 200,000 votes and nearly a 29-point margin of victory!
Think of it. A mere eight years ago, a Democratic member of Congress had not been elected in PA-06 for more than 160 years. And now with your support, Chrissy was re-elected by a higher margin than the previous four elections. That. Is. Historic!
Chrissy couldn’t do it without you. Throughout this campaign, I’ve asked you to show up to support Chrissy and PA Dems in every way possible, and you have done it. You signed and carried petitions to get her on the ballot. You canvassed, made phone calls, and joined text banking programs with PA Dems. You put Chrissy’s name out there and into your front yards with her yard signs. You supported her campaign with donations. You had those tough and sometimes awkward conversations with friends, family members, and neighbors about why their vote matters and what issues are on the ballot this election. You volunteered on Election Day as greeters, observers, and supporters. And you voted! Chrissy’s victory belongs to you and all of us.
Let’s be clear, the election is over, but there is work to be done. So please, keep reaching out to Chrissy and her team when you have questions about legislation, have an opinion to share, or need help with a federal agency. She is here to help you and serve our community and country.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143188027/659374818/468628139?refcode=jtk1333-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzYxODI3ZC05NWRjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2ExYjg5NjIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sVl5hspxUCnY45FSdMAMUamtgL0bsNvDhtVqlgC3aCQ=&emci=5b7485a2-74dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&emdi=9761827d-95dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&ceid=21278485)
Finally, because we really do believe in managing our campaign finances responsibly AND keeping our beautiful PA-06 community clean and green, please return your yard signs to either your local Democratic zone or to **[_CCDC’s HQ in West Chester_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143188028/659374819/1354681555?refcode=jtk1333-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzYxODI3ZC05NWRjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2ExYjg5NjIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sVl5hspxUCnY45FSdMAMUamtgL0bsNvDhtVqlgC3aCQ=&emci=5b7485a2-74dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&emdi=9761827d-95dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&ceid=21278485)** or **[_BCDC’s HQ in Reading._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143188029/659374820/-1938897044?refcode=jtk1333-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NzYxODI3ZC05NWRjLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2ExYjg5NjIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sVl5hspxUCnY45FSdMAMUamtgL0bsNvDhtVqlgC3aCQ=&emci=5b7485a2-74dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&emdi=9761827d-95dc-f111-bf5b-000d3a1b8962&ceid=21278485)**

# **Markwayne Mullin rules out amnesty despite Trump 's openness to immigration deal**
Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said the administration **[won't grant amnesty to illegal immigrants,](https://substack.com/redirect/704f3d79-8e9a-441d-9874-6561a43128dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** even as Trump suggested in a "60 Minutes" interview that his deportation push may have been "too tough" and expressed interest in working with Democrats on legal status for non-criminal immigrants who are employed and paying taxes.
